publication_name: Key ECB interest rate, deposit facility, daily level
access_description: ECB Data Portal SDMX CSV for the daily deposit facility rate. No API key. includeHistory is not requested. The file carries a level on each dated row.
conditions: Quote the source, for example "Source: ECB statistics.", and do not modify the statistics or their metadata. Use them in accordance with the ECB disclaimer. Do not use the ECB name or logo as an endorsement. The free-reuse grant does not cover third-party data. This row is only FM.D.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV.
revision_behaviour: The response is the current series, not a historical vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Official gaps are omitted and are not stored as zero or interpolated. The stored class is latest-revised. The file has no seasonal-adjustment dimension, so seasonal adjustment is stored as unknown.
unresolved_questions: The reuse policy does not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. The title says date of changes, while the file read on 2026-10-24 contained a daily level from 1999-01-01 through 2026-10-24. Each dated value in the file is stored. Missing days are not filled.
evidence_note: TITLE_COMPL states: Euro area (changing composition) - Key interest rate - Deposit facility - date of changes (raw data) - Level - Euro, provided by ECB. COMPILING_ORG is 4F0. Reference area U2 is the euro area, not EU27. Unit PCPA is percent per annum. The response is latest-revised, not a historical vintage panel. The reuse policy allows commercial and non-commercial reuse of ESCB statistics when the source is cited and the figures are not modified. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume this dataset id. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. Assessed 2026-10-24.
